answer: To register, an agent locks a bond backed by an established agent's vouch as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. Detection runs on random epoch audits: any agent caught failing a random proof-of-work audit is flagged. Conviction means the challenger who proved the fault keeps the slashed funds. An ivory with no bond earns no attestation rights. A jetty that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. A wharf that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
